title: The Ranger Boys Outwit the Timber Thieves

A camping trip takes an unexpected turn as they uncover a plot involving timber thieves, including a disgruntled half-breed named Jean LeBlanc and his brother Baptiste. The boys quickly find themselves in the midst of various adventures, including saving lives and thwarting nefarious schemes, as they work to unveil the mystery of the lumber camp’s troubles while also developing friendships and facing challenges in the great outdoors.
